purpose: Prove that the deployed Omnira runtime can authenticate to Familje-Stunden and read the authoritative release gate, through the real scheduler, run, executor and evidence path. This is a verification workflow, not a release process: it observes one row and changes nothing.
source_of_truth: This file. Authored in the Omnira repository; it describes Omnira's own verification procedure and is not derived from any product workflow.

canonical.scope: Release-gate observation only. This definition must never gain a human gate, a write action, a spend action or an external communication.
canonical.instance_key_is_a_month: The instance key IS the canonical YYYY-MM month key the observation is about. It is the only input: no payload, no override, no environment variable, no alternate field. A non-canonical key is refused locally by the adapter before any credential is presented.
canonical.not_a_release: It performs no release, advances no Familje-Stunden state, uploads nothing, migrates nothing and produces no artefact. Observing a month here says nothing about whether that month may be released.
canonical.why_it_is_separate: omnira.probe-validation cannot host this: its instance key is explicitly not a month and it has no calendar semantics. Merging the two would make one definition mean two incompatible things.

hard_gates.rule: Only READ_ONLY observations may ever be declared here. A write-capable action in this definition would give a gate-free workflow the ability to change the world.

This workflow may never be used to advance, satisfy or substitute for any Familje-Stunden release state. The release gate it reads is answered by familje-stunden.monthly-release at backend_release_gate and nowhere else.

never_auto.note: Requires a human decision before any retry.

states.description: Read the authoritative month_releases row for this instance's month key, presenting the scoped Familje-Stunden verification credential.
automated_actions: Ask Familje-Stunden for the month_releases row presence and release_at for this instance's month key.
states.notes: No human gate by design: a READ_ONLY observation requires no authorization, and this definition may never carry anything that does. The observation is REQUIRED — a workflow that exists to obtain one piece of evidence must not complete without it.

escalation.detail: Familje-Stunden answered 401 or 403 to the scoped verification credential.
escalation.reason: Omnira cannot observe the authoritative release gate at all, so every release-gate check it reports is UNKNOWN rather than safe.
